description.en: An example chat widget built only on cmux-extension-sdk: when an agent reads a GitHub pull request, a card under the call shows its state and checks, paged five at a time. The pull requests it showed are listed in a sidebar section.

scopes.net:api.github.com: Read the public pull request and its checks when GitHub is not connected.
scopes.actions:run: Open the pull request or a check in a browser tab when you click it.
scopes.storage:local: Remember which page of checks each card shows, and the pull requests the cards showed.

optionalScopes.integration:github:read: Use your connected GitHub account (private repositories) without seeing its token.
